title: Adaptive Query Routing: A Tier-Based Framework for Hybrid Retrieval Across Financial, Legal, and Medical Documents
abstract: arXiv:2604.14222v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become the standard paradigm for grounding Large Language Model outputs in external knowledge. Lumer et al. presented the first systematic evaluation comparing vector-based agentic RAG against hierarchical node-based reasoning systems for financial document QA across 1,200 SEC filings, finding vector-based systems achieved a 68% win rate. Concurrently, the PageIndex framework reported 98.7% accuracy on FinanceBench through purely reasoning-based retrieval. This paper extends their work by: (i) implementing and evaluating three retrieval configurations: Vector RAG, Tree Reasoning, and the proposed Adaptive Hybrid Retrieval (AHR), on a small controlled corpus of financial, legal, and medical documents; (ii) introducing a four-tier query complexity benchmark; and (iii) employing LLM-as-judge evaluation with GPT-4o-mini. translated_title: 自适应查询路由：一种基于层级的跨金融、法律和医疗文档混合检索框架
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为将大语言模型输出锚定于外部知识的标准范式。Lumer等人首次进行了系统性评估，在1,200份SEC文件上比较了基于向量的智能体RAG与基于层级节点的推理系统在金融文档问答任务中的表现，发现基于向量的系统取得了68%的胜率。与此同时，PageIndex框架通过纯推理式检索在FinanceBench上报告了98.7%的准确率。本文在上述工作的基础上进行了扩展：（i）在一个由金融、法律和医疗文档组成的小型受控语料库上，实现并评估了三种检索配置：向量RAG、树形推理以及所提出的自适应混合检索（AHR）；（ii）引入了一个四级查询复杂度基准；（iii）采用GPT-4o-mini进行LLM-as-judge评估。实验表明，树形推理获得了最高的总体得分（摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 本文提出自适应混合检索（AHR）框架，通过四级查询复杂度基准在向量RAG与树形推理之间进行自适应查询路由，从而提升跨金融、法律和医疗文档的混合检索效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Adaptive Hybrid Retrieval (AHR) framework that adaptively routes queries between Vector RAG and Tree Reasoning using a four-tier query complexity benchmark, improving hybrid retrieval across financial, legal, and medical documents.
